snippet.title: Hymn of Surrender (cover) Matt Redman
snippet.description:
Here is our cover of "Hymn of Surrender" by Matt Redman. This song was recorded live as a part of our online service on June 14, 2020.

To view the entire service, check out our "Online Services" playlist.

Need prayer? We'd love to connect! Just text "PRAY" to (314) 926-1800 and we'll connect you with someone who can pray with you.
